# Rierino

> Rierino is the execution-first, AI-native low-code platform for building, orchestrating, and governing enterprise backend systems — with embedded agent execution, saga orchestration, and composable control across commerce, data, content, and operations.

Rierino is a secure, low-code development platform purpose-built for AI-native enterprise systems. It enables developers to rapidly build, orchestrate, and scale backend workflows across commerce, product data, content, and business operations — without sacrificing control, extensibility, or governance. With embedded agent orchestration, a built-in saga engine, contextual automation, and governance-first design, Rierino brings intelligent execution and customization to every layer of the enterprise stack.

Rierino has been building AI-native execution capabilities since 2020, and is recognized as a SourceForge Top Performer across Headless CMS, Headless Ecommerce, and PIM categories. Selected by Fast Company as a promising startup driving transformative growth across industries.

## Getting Started — Community Edition (Free)

Rierino Community Edition is a free, full-featured deployment of Rierino Core available as a single-node AWS AMI. It is designed for developers, architects, and platform teams who want to start building execution-first backends — with orchestrated workflows, integrations, composable APIs, internal tools, and governed AI agent actions — without turning every automation into a custom-code project.

- **Free to use** with unlimited users and applications
- Deploys in your own AWS environment via AWS Marketplace
- Full access to low-code microservices design, API development, saga orchestration, rule engine, and visual UI builder
- Ideal for MVPs, POCs, small-scale projects, integration testing, and hands-on learning
- Upgrade path to Scale Pro and Enterprise as requirements grow

- [Community Edition Page](https://rierino.com/community)
- [Community Edition on AWS Marketplace](https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/pp/prodview-up2fcxku3k742)
- [Community Edition Blog: A Practical Starting Point for Agentic Development](https://rierino.com/blog/community-edition-agentic-backend)

## Core Benefits

- Accelerate enterprise development with a secure, low-code platform built for AI-native architecture
- Enable execution-first agent orchestration across backend workflows and external systems
- Build tool-using AI agents that connect to governed backend logic combining AI assistance with workflows, rules, and reusable building blocks
- Consolidate product, content, and process logic with a modular and composable platform
- Govern and scale AI-driven logic with fine-grained access control, audit trails, and observability
- Modernize legacy systems through visual orchestration and microservice-aligned architecture
- Reduce vendor lock-in by building fully customized logic and experiences with full ownership
- Deploy cloud-agnostic: private, public, hybrid, or on-prem environments

## Key Features

- **AI Agent Builder**: Design and execute backend AI agents with contextual decision-making, event triggers, HTTP, WebSocket, MQ, and saga orchestration across services and channels
- **Saga Orchestration Engine**: Built-in engine for distributed logic, multi-step workflows, retries, compensations, and state machines — not a bolt-on
- **Low-Code Microservices**: Build complex microservices with drag-and-drop — from simple CRUD to business logic and ML model execution — without writing code
- **Composable Commerce**: Orchestrate custom B2C, B2B, and marketplace commerce flows across pricing, catalog, checkout, inventory, and fulfillment
- **Low-Code PIM**: Centralize, enrich, validate, and syndicate multilingual product data at scale with AI-based transformation and workflow automation
- **Headless CMS**: Deliver localized content across channels, powered by embedded AI generation and workflow triggers
- **BPM Engine**: Automate approvals, tasks, escalations, and service integrations using visual saga flows and state machines
- **RAI Assistant**: On-platform generative AI for content creation, translation, markdown styling, template logic, query generation, and flow structuring
- **Business Rules Engine**: Configurable real-time decisioning for any domain — pricing, fraud detection, routing, validation
- **Multi-Channel Execution**: Run the same logic across web, mobile, API, or headless deployments
- **Enterprise-Grade Security**: Enforced RBAC, runtime isolation, encrypted storage, audit logs, environment controls, and execution policy enforcement
- **Open Integration Architecture**: Connect to SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Kafka, and any REST, GraphQL, OData, SOAP, or WebSocket API

## Products

### Platform Components

- [Rierino Core Platform](https://rierino.com/platform/core): The secure low-code foundation for building modular backend logic, APIs, microservices, and workflows with full governance and developer control.
- [AI Agent Builder](https://rierino.com/platform/agent): Create and execute backend AI agents with contextual decision-making, event triggers, tool use, and saga orchestration across services and channels.
- [RAI – Rierino AI Assistant](https://rierino.com/platform/rai): Embedded generative AI for content creation, translation, markdown styling, query generation, and template logic — fully integrated inside the platform.
- [Community Edition](https://rierino.com/community): Free, full-featured single-node deployment of Rierino Core on AWS for MVPs, prototyping, and small-scale projects.

### Modular Solutions

- [Composable Commerce](https://rierino.com/solutions/commerce): Execute B2C, B2B, marketplace, and agentic commerce flows across pricing, checkout, inventory, and catalog with API-first flexibility.
- [PIM – Product Information Management](https://rierino.com/solutions/pim): Manage, enrich, validate, and automate multilingual product data at scale with low-code orchestration and AI-based data transformation.
- [Headless CMS](https://rierino.com/solutions/cms): Centralized content orchestration and delivery across channels, with AI-powered generation and flow control.
- [BPM – Business Process Management](https://rierino.com/solutions/bpm): Automate backend processes, approvals, and escalations using a saga flow engine and integration triggers.
- [Personalize](https://rierino.com/solutions/personalize): Deliver real-time personalized experiences powered by AI, customer segmentation, and dynamic content control.

## Use Cases

- Build tool-using AI agents that execute real work through orchestrated workflows, integrations, and APIs
- Automate multilingual product data onboarding, enrichment, and syndication at scale
- Build custom pricing, checkout, and inventory logic for B2B, B2C, and marketplace commerce
- Create agentic workflows combining AI assistance with backend rules, queries, and services
- Centralize content management and localization across websites and mobile apps
- Enable workflow approvals, escalations, and integrations without custom code
- Build smart internal tools with embedded AI assistance and governed execution
- Personalize customer experiences using AI-powered segmentation and targeting
- Replace legacy systems with secure, low-code microservice orchestration
- Govern backend logic with audit trails, environment controls, and access policies
- Orchestrate integration layers across enterprise systems (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Kafka)

## Industry Applications

- **Ecommerce & Retail**: Power omnichannel B2C and B2B experiences — from PIM and CMS to cart, pricing, and fulfillment logic — all with low-code control and embedded AI.
- **Public Sector & Government**: Digitize internal workflows, case management, citizen services, and program orchestration with secure automation and compliance-first governance.
- **Banking & Financial Services**: Build scalable agent-based logic for onboarding, approval flows, risk management, and compliance with enterprise-grade governance.
- **Telecom & Utilities**: Orchestrate product catalogs, self-service portals, and workflow automations across complex service ecosystems.
- **B2B & Manufacturing**: Automate backend processes like quote-to-cash, product configuration, partner onboarding, and supply chain coordination using composable modules and flows.

## Platform Differentiators

- First low-code platform with embedded AI execution and orchestration since 2020
- Designed for backend orchestration, not just frontend workflows or form builders
- Built-in saga orchestration engine for distributed logic, retries, and compensations
- Native support for AI agent execution with full API, event, and data access
- On-platform generative AI assistant (RAI) for content, templates, and automation
- Free Community Edition on AWS Marketplace for immediate hands-on building
- Fine-grained governance with runtime isolation, RBAC, and environment controls
- Fully modular and composable architecture — no black-box constraints or forced UIs
- Cloud-agnostic deployment with full developer control over pipelines and integrations
- Integrates seamlessly with enterprise ecosystems (e.g. SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, Kafka)
- Built to accelerate digital transformation in regulated or complex industries
- SourceForge Top Performer in Headless CMS, Headless Ecommerce, and PIM
- Selected by Fast Company as a promising startup for transformative growth
